title: No inferring character or potential from presentation signals
rationale: AI may support practice, feedback and reflection; it must not infer empathy, personality, charisma, employability or leadership potential from voice, accent, facial expression or discussion activity.
fix: Describe observable work or the person's own stated reflection; drop the inference from how they sound, look or how much they talked.
unless: \b(?:must not|may not|should not|never|do not|does not|don't|doesn't|cannot|can't|is not|are not|isn't|aren't|nothing|no)\b\s+(?:[\w'-]+\s+){0,3}?(?:infer|inferred|inferring|judge[ds]?|judging|read(?:s|ing)?|guess(?:es|ed)?|assess(?:ed|es)?|score[sd]?)\b

cooccurrence.message: Infers a character trait or potential from a presentation signal (voice, accent, face, talk-time).
with: \b(?:voice|vocal|tone of voice|accent(?:ed)?|face|facial|expressions?|smile|eye contact|talk[- ]?time|speaking time|air ?time|how much (?:he|she|they) (?:talk|talked|spoke|speaks)|discussion activity|talked the most|spoke the most|quiet(?:er|est)?|loud(?:er|est)?)\b
